scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vm-tipping-2026/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @vm-tipping-2026/shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vm-tipping-2026/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vm-tipping-2026/shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vm-tipping-2026/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
